description_en: Remove a cloud connector instance from an instance group
description_zh: 将云连接器实例从实例组中移除
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc remove-iot-cloud-connector-from-group --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --iot-cloud-connector-group-id iotccg-g00epppbi9di9y0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveIoTCloudConnectorFromGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance. Valid values for N: 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 云连接器实例ID。N的取值范围：1~20
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance group
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across different requests and contain no more than 64 ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without removing the cloud connector instance from the instance group. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether the request complies with service limits. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会将云连接器实例从实例组中移除。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html API to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例组所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id
